Process Manager  Eclerx (Investment Banking Operations)        -Feb 2024  

Responsibility • Led GenAI-driven automation initiatives to optimize operational processes within the Equity      
Derivatives (Exotic Options) domain.  

• Partnered with internal and client stakeholders to understand business challenges, gather 
requirements, and identify high-impact automation opportunities.  

• Managed end-to-end automation projects, from process assessment and solution design to 
implementation, UAT, and production rollout. 

• Specialized in reconciling exotic derivatives, including structured notes and auto-callable deals, 
ensuring alignment with legal documentation (term-sheets, confirmations) to mitigate operational 
risks and ensure compliance. 

• Proactively addressed discrepancies in payoffs and economic parameters, collaborating with regional 
desks and drafting teams to preserve P&L integrity and accurate financial reporting. 

Internship (1 Month)

Responsibility • Worked on Key Risk Indicators and made trends using Power BI and Advance Excel. 
• Read and understood SEBI Circulars on Mutual Funds.

Control Self-Assessment. 
• Learned the complete Structure and the functioning of Enterprise Risk Management in HDFC

Equity Research 
& Risk

 2023
